layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid for galleries. Mix of col-span-full, col-span-4, col-span-8. Avoid perfect symmetry.
layout_and_spacing.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders and negative space.

motion_and_interaction.scroll: Mandatory use of Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Images: subtle scale-up (1.02) with image brightness increase. Links: under-line expansion or color shift to accent_primary.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Framer Motion staggered fade-ups (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1).
motion_and_interaction.lightbox: Framer Motion AnimatePresence for smooth full-screen image expansion.

components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Override default borders to be 'border-b only' (flair-less, editorial style). Use background-transparent.
components_strategy.buttons: Flat, rectangular. text-primary border border-text_primary hover:bg-text_primary hover:text-background_primary transition-colors. No rounded corners.
components_strategy.cards: DO NOT USE default cards. Use bare divs. Image on top, typography below. No borders, no shadows.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky, Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl, bg-[#F5F2EB]/80, 1px bottom border-light. Logo centered or left.
components_strategy.lightbox_modal: Use Shadcn Dialog, customized to have a #2A2421 background with 95% opacity, removing close button background for minimalism.

sections_blueprint.name: Hero
sections_blueprint.layout: 90vh full-bleed image/video. bg-black/30 overlay (or gradient to transparent) so text is readable. Content pinned to bottom-left or center.
sections_blueprint.content: H1: 'Bill Farr'. Subtitle: 'Western & Travel Photographer'. Subtle 'Scroll down' indicator.

sections_blueprint.name: About / Story
sections_blueprint.layout: 2-column grid. Left: large portrait image. Right: editorial text, large drop-cap or massive quote.
sections_blueprint.content: Brief bio, establishing the human connection and emotional strength.

sections_blueprint.name: Portfolio - Western
sections_blueprint.layout: Asymmetric Bento/Tetris grid (md:grid-cols-12). Images spanning 4, 8, or 6 columns. Generous gap-8.

sections_blueprint.name: Portfolio - Travel
sections_blueprint.layout: Horizontal scroll section or alternating left/right prominent images to contrast the Western gallery layout.

sections_blueprint.name: Journal / Blog
sections_blueprint.layout: List view. Huge typography titles. Hovering title reveals a small following image (via Framer motion) or simple elegant image next to text.

sections_blueprint.name: Contact / Booking
sections_blueprint.layout: Dark background section (#2A2421). 2 columns: Left side text/email/socials. Right side booking form.
sections_blueprint.features: Minimalist inputs with bottom borders only.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure you build the site using HTML/Tailwind for the layouts, applying the exact colors, fonts, and generous spacing specified. Implement Lenis for scrolling. Use the provided high-quality Unsplash/Pexels URLs exclusively for all imagery (no placeholders). Forms and Dialogs should be implemented using customized Shadcn components matching the flat, border-only minimalist aesthetic.
